environment.description: AWS Lambda function behind API Gateway (HTTP API, no additional request validation). CloudWatch Logs are consumed by a downstream SIEM (Splunk) that renders log fields in a web UI without output encoding. The Lambda execution role has cloudwatch:PutLogEvents. No log field sanitization is configured on the CloudWatch log group or the Splunk HTTP Event Collector ingestion pipeline. CDN serves scripts over HTTPS with no integrity verification enforcement at the browser level (older internal browser without SRI support).

config.log_destination: CloudWatch -> Splunk HEC (raw ingestion, no field sanitization)
config.siem_rendering: Splunk dashboard with HTML rendering enabled for log fields
config.browser_sri_support: not enforced (internal Electron app v2.x without SRI)
